chunks: Muhammad ibn Hammam narrated to us; he said: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik narrated to me; he said: Abbad ibn Ya'qub narrated to me; he said: Khallad al-Sa'igh narrated to us, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:
The Sufyani is inevitable, and he will not emerge except in Rajab. A man asked him: O Abu Abdillah, when he emerges, what will be our state? He said: When that happens, you are to keep to us.

key_terms.إِلَيْنَا: To us (the Imams/Ahl al-Bayt), indicating adherence to the Imams during the emergence.
key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيُّ: Al-Sufyani, a prominent eschatological figure in Shia tradition who emerges before the appearance of the Mahdi.
key_terms.رَجَبٌ: The seventh month of the Islamic lunar calendar, specified here as the time of Sufyani's emergence.

ai.seo_question: When will al-Sufyani emerge according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the inevitability of al-Sufyani’s emergence, specifically linking it to the month of Rajab, a detail emphasized in Shia eschatological traditions. When asked about the believers' condition, the Imam’s response 'إلينا' (to us) signifies that the Ahl al-Bayt will serve as the central authority and source of guidance during this period of tribulation, reinforcing the concept of waiting for the Mahdi under their spiritual leadership.
